phases.name: The Graves Open
phases.say: Rise. All of you. Rise and be judged.

say.open: (A soldier in white stands at the shrine's door with a trumpet, and lifts it to his lips.)
say.death: (The trumpet falls silent. The dead lie down again.)

bestiary.lore: The card of reckoning and rising: a herald of the shrine who sounds the last call, and rises from every fall to sound it again.
bestiary.weakness: Dark, heavily. Interrupt the trumpet while it charges.
bestiary.pattern: Every fourth turn the last trumpet on everyone (Deaf, sometimes Stun); verdicts on the weakest armor between, and every Front struck on the odd turns; he rises when hurt. When the graves open the trumpet sounds every third turn.
